reviews.review_msg: Very supportive prof who takes time to give you feedback on your work and checkpoints for larger projects to help you track your process. Readings were a little heavy (page number wise) and you have to write weekly reading responses. If you're fine with a busier workload, I highly recommend her class!
Nice choice for this course! Great Prof...

She is smart, kind, caring, and approachable. Class was fun but had more than avg workload. She goes out of her way to help students and is a fair marker. The class content covers many learning traditions that has influenced educational technologies. There is a fun 20% project; you can pick anything to learn and share it in class... easy full marks
